args.expression: (() => { const sb = document.querySelector('.issue-sidebar'); const labelNames = sb ? Array.from(sb.querySelectorAll('.labels a, a[href*="/labels/"]')).map(a => a.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean) : []; const title = (document.querySelector('h1')||{}).textContent ? document.querySelector('h1').textContent.trim() : null; const articles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.timeline article')).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); const header = (document.querySelector('.ui.attached.header')||{}).textContent || ''; return {title, labelNames, labelCount: labelNames.length, milestone: sb?Array.from(sb.querySelectorAll('a[href*="milestone="]')).map(a=>a.textContent.trim()):[], assignees: sb?Array.from(sb.querySelectorAll('a[href*="assignee="]')).map(a=>a.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean):[], articles, header: header.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,150)}; })()

(() => { const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).filter(a=>{const h=a.getAttribute('href')||''; return /label|milestone|assignee|user\//.test(h);}).map(a=>({t:a.textContent.trim().slice(0,60), h:a.getAttribute('href')})); const arts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article')).map(a=>a.textContent.trim()); return {links: all, articles: arts}; })()

(() => { const sb=document.querySelector('.issue-sidebar'); const out={}; out.sidebarHTMLsnippet = sb? sb.innerHTML.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,0):null; const items=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="labels="]')); out.items=items.map(a=>({t:a.textContent.trim(), cls:a.className, desc:a.getAttribute('data-label-desc')||'', parentCls:(a.parentElement.className||'').slice(0,60)})); const arts=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.comment, .timeline-item, .markdown-body')).map(e=>e.textContent.trim().slice(0,80)); out.arts=arts; const h=document.querySelector('.issue-title')||document.querySelector('h1'); out.titleEl = h? h.outerHTML.slice(0,200):null; return out; })()

(() => { const bodies = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.comment .render-content, .timeline .render-content, article .render-content')).map(e=>e.textContent.trim()); const stateEl=document.querySelector('.issue-state, .ui.red.label, [data-state]'); const closeBtn=!!document.querySelector('.ui.button.closed, button[action*="close"]'); const headerBtn=document.querySelector('#issue-title-display .ui.button, .issue-title .ui.button'); const openSign = document.body.innerText.includes('Close Issue'); const labelsList = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.labels-list a.item')).map(a=>a.textContent.trim()); return {bodies, openSign, labelsList, openedText: (document.querySelector('.issue-title + *')||{}).textContent}; })()

(() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#issue-list li, .issue.list li, .flex-item')); const res = []; for (const n of [1,2,3,4]) { const a = document.querySelector('a[href="/bench/bench-repo/issues/'+n+'"]'); if(!a) {res.push({n, missing:true}); continue;} let li = a.closest('li') || a.closest('.flex-item') || a.parentElement.parentElement; res.push({n, title: a.textContent.trim(), row: li? li.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,200):null}); } return {url: location.href, openCount: (document.body.innerText.match(/(\d+) Open/)||[])[1], res}; })()

(() => { const out=[]; document.querySelectorAll('input.checkbox-toggle').forEach(cb=>{ let li = cb.closest('li') || cb.closest('.flex-item'); if(li) out.push(li.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,180)); }); return out; })()

(() => { const lis = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#issue-list li, ul.issue.list li, .list > li, li')); const rows = lis.filter(li => li.querySelector('a[href*="/issues/"]')).map(li => li.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,160)); return rows; })()
